about: Every sound, music piece, voice and line generated with ElevenLabs (docs/SOUND_PLAN.md). tools/audio/generate.mjs makes the missing or changed ones into art/source/audio/ (local); tools/audio/review.mjs builds the listening page. `pick` records the owner's favourite take. Owner decisions (15 Oct 2026): eleven_v4; one voice per character for both languages.
palette: Warm, round, playful children's cartoon sound, no harsh highs, nothing scary.

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Miłka / Tiny
voices.description: An adult female voice actress performing a small but very strong, playful triceratops in a children's cartoon. A slightly lower, warm, distinctive voice with a bit of texture, full of confidence and cheeky humour; she lands a joke with a sure little pause and a hearty giggle. Bold and friendly, not squeaky. Clean studio recording, close microphone. Speaks Polish natively, standard Polish accent, and also clear English.
voices.text: Cześć, jestem Miłka! Chcesz usłyszeć dowcip? Jak nazywa się śpiący dinozaur? Chrapozaur! Hi, hi! Wyglądam na małą, a jestem najsilniejsza z nas!
voices.note: Owner, round 5: Miłka lower, more distinctive and confident than Rudzia (as in the cartoon).

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Czupur / Rocky
voices.description: An adult male voice actor performing an energetic young parasaurolophus character in a Polish children's cartoon. Native Polish speaker, standard Polish accent. Bold, fast and excitable, slightly raspy, always in a hurry, with loud happy shouts; a proud little show-off, but warm and friendly. Clean studio recording, close microphone.
voices.text: Cześć, jestem Czupur! Najszybszy dinozaur w dżungli! Mam trąbkę na głowie. Tuuu, tuuu! Kiedyś przybiję piątkę z Giganto. Zobaczysz!

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Dudek / Bill
voices.description: An adult male voice actor performing a gentle, timid young brachiosaurus in a children's cartoon. Soft, warm, a little breathy and hesitant, slower pace, sweet and kind; he lights up and giggles when food is mentioned. Clean studio recording, close microphone. Speaks Polish natively, standard Polish accent, and also clear English.
voices.text: Cześć, jestem Dudek! Masz coś do jedzenia? Mam najlepszy nos w dżungli. Wywęszę każdy owoc! Boję się nawet ważek. Ale z tobą jest mi raźniej.

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Rudzia / Mazu
voices.description: An adult female voice actress performing a clever, curious young ankylosaurus scientist in a children's cartoon. A light, bright, higher voice, clear and precise, sweet and earnest, a little dreamy when she talks about stars; articulate and gentle, never shrill. Clean studio recording, close microphone. Speaks Polish natively, standard Polish accent, and also clear English.
voices.text: Cześć, jestem Rudzia! Wiem prawie wszystko o dinozaurach. W Gigantopedii zapisuję wszystko, co robi Giganto. Najpierw patrzymy, potem rysujemy. Tak robią naukowcy!
voices.note: Owner, round 5: in the cartoon Rudzia sounds a little higher than Miłka; Miłka is lower, more distinctive and confident.

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Giganto
voices.description: An adult male voice actor performing a huge, gentle giant dinosaur in a children's cartoon. Very deep, slow, soft and kind, a warm rumbling voice that speaks only a word or two, with friendly growls and a cosy, funny side. Never scary. Clean studio recording, close microphone. Speaks Polish natively, standard Polish accent, and also clear English.
voices.text: GRRRAU! …Cześć. Mrrr… Lubię cię. Tup. Tup. TUP! Ziiiew… Dużo dziś tupania. Mrrr… Ładnie rysujesz. GRRRAU! …Przepraszam. To z radości.

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Narrator
voices.description: An adult female storyteller narrating a gentle children's cartoon: warm, calm and smiling, clear and friendly, like reading a bedtime story to a small child, with a little sparkle of wonder. Clean studio recording, close microphone. Speaks Polish natively, standard Polish accent, and also clear English.
voices.text: Dudek wywęszył kokos, ale boi się iść sam. Pomożesz mu? Miłka maluje obrazek. Szuka kwiatka, który będzie jej pozował! Nowy skarb: muszelka!

lines.text: Cześć, jestem Miłka! Chcesz usłyszeć dowcip?
lines.say: [cheerfully] Cześć, jestem Miłka! Chcesz usłyszeć dowcip?

lines.text: Jak nazywa się śpiący dinozaur? Chrapozaur!
lines.say: Jak nazywa się śpiący dinozaur? [short pause] Chrapozaur! [giggles]

lines.text: Ładnie rysujesz! Jak na moich obrazkach.
lines.say: [warmly] Ładnie rysujesz! Jak na moich obrazkach.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Tiny! Want to hear a joke?
lines.say: [cheerfully] Hi, I'm Tiny! Want to hear a joke?

lines.text: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino-snore!
lines.say: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? [short pause] A dino-snore! [giggles]

lines.text: Lovely drawing! Just like my paintings.
lines.say: [warmly] Lovely drawing! Just like my paintings.

lines.text: Cześć, jestem Czupur! Najszybszy dinozaur w dżungli!
lines.say: [excited] Cześć, jestem Czupur! Najszybszy dinozaur w dżungli!

lines.text: Jestem parazaur… paralozaur… Jestem dinozaurem z trąbką!
lines.say: Jestem parazaur… paralozaur… [laughs] Jestem dinozaurem z trąbką!

lines.text: Ty rysujesz, a ja trąbię. Tuuu! To dla ciebie!
lines.say: [excited] Ty rysujesz, a ja trąbię. Tuuu! To dla ciebie!

lines.text: Hi, I'm Rocky! The fastest dino in the jungle!
lines.say: [excited] Hi, I'm Rocky! The fastest dino in the jungle!

lines.text: I'm a parasaur… a paralo… I'm a dino with a trumpet!
lines.say: I'm a parasaur… a paralo… [laughs] I'm a dino with a trumpet!

lines.text: You draw, I toot. Toot! That one's for you!
lines.say: [excited] You draw, I toot. Toot! That one's for you!

gentle: Gentle, sweet and playful: soft attack, music-box delicate, a little airy room. Never harsh or dry.
pickZero: pick 0: none of the takes; the cue in `compare` keeps its own pick.
sayAbout: `say`: how a game line is performed when its plain text is misread (owner never sees it). giganto-line3-pl: 'Ziiiew…' was heard as 'Jezu'.
